result.text:
I've added all three improvements (repeated commands, the sonar and guarded runs) to the image. All 55 tests pass: the 16 that were already there and 39 new ones. The package isn't saved to a file yet; it doesn't have a file name, so I can set one and save it if you want.

## Design
The old version used a chain of `ifTrue:` checks to read commands, and the crawler had one `moveUp`/`moveDown`/… method per direction. Both are gone now; each part of the new behaviour is its own class.

- **Commands** (`CrawlerCommand` class `for: aCharacter`): each character becomes a command object, and anything unrecognised becomes `InvalidCommand`.
  - `AdvanceCommand`, `RetreatCommand`, `TurnClockwiseCommand` and `TurnCounterClockwiseCommand` inherit from `RepeatableCommand`.
  - `RepetitionCommand` holds the digit plus two and asks the previous command to repeat itself. Only repeatable commands can; every other command, and `NoPreviousCommand` at the start of the string, raises an invalid-repetition error.
  - `StartGuardedRunCommand` and `EndGuardedRunCommand` handle `(` and `)`.
- **Movement:** each facing now just gives a `direction` (such as `0@1`). Advancing moves along it and retreating moves along its opposite, so silt slides the right way either way.
- **Sonar and ground:** `SeabedSonar mapping:` answers the `Ground` at a position, and any position not in the map is `FirmSand`. The ground decides what happens:
  - `FirmSand` moves one cell.
  - `Boulder` blocks moving onto it and turning on it.
  - `Silt` makes the crawler slide `nextInteger: 10` cells.
- **Guarded runs:** the crawler is either in an `UnguardedRun` or a `GuardedRun`. A `GuardedRun` records how to undo each move and turn. Each command runs inside `guard:`, so on any `Error` it undoes the moves in reverse order, goes back to unguarded and `pass`es the error on. It also turns silt, a second `(` and a missing `)` into errors.
- **Instance creation:** `SurveyCrawler at:facing:` still works (firm sand everywhere, a real `Random`). The full version, `at:facing:detectingGroundWith:slidingWith:`, lets the tests use a map and a `ScriptedRandom`, a test class that gives chosen slide distances.

## Decisions on cases the requirements didn't cover
- **Sliding into a boulder:** the crawler stops in the cell before it, with no exception.
- **A digit in the wrong place:** after another digit, `(`, `)` or at the start it raises its own invalid-repetition error (`'a00'`, `'(0)'`, `'(a)0'`, `'0'`).
- **`)` with no open guarded run:** raises an error.
- **Errors outside a guarded run:** processing stops, and the moves already made stay.
- **Undoing:** it doesn't ask the sonar again, because the crawler is going back over cells it just crossed.
- **After a failed guarded run:** the crawler is unguarded again, so a later sequence works normally.

## Changes to existing code
- The test class moved to `SurveyCrawler-Tests`.
- `invalidCommandErrorDescription` moved to the class side. test06 now uses it there, and test16 now uses `should:raise:withMessageText:`.
- I removed the unused class-side variable `facings`.
